commands.name: todo
commands.description: Create a todo item (auto-tagged #todo). Inline #tags add extra tags.

params.name: text
params.description: What needs doing. Trailing #-prefixed words become extra tags.

commands.name: done
commands.description: Mark a todo done. Matches the first #todo item whose title or content contains the search text.

params.name: match
params.description: Substring of the todo's title or content (case-insensitive).
